snippet.title: Krystal Is Back - Star Fox Event Horizon
snippet.description:
20 years ago Estelle Ellis voiced Krystal in Star Fox Adventures. Now she has returned to reprise her role in the fanmade game Star Fox Event Horizon.

You can support Estelle Ellis and Star Fox Event Horizon here: https://www.patreon.com/starfoxeh
You can download the most recent versions of SF Event Horizon here: https://www.moddb.com/mods/star-fox-event-horizon
Estelle Ellis' Twitter: https://twitter.com/RealKrystalFox
Trailer music by Adam Halpin: https://www.youtube.com/user/StygianWhite
